description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Cost 2 charges of Ghost-Static

Duration 1 minute

Your Rig braces and overplates. It gains temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level, kept in a pool separate from your own and from its own Hit Points. Damage dealt to your Rig comes out of this pool first. When the duration ends, any remaining temporary Hit Points are lost.

cinderfall.incomplete: Triggered/activated temp-HP-only grant (would be SKIP on that basis alone) and the pool it grants belongs to "the Rig's own" HP, i.e. presupposes the Rig has a real, separately-tracked HP total -- [RIG-NO-ACTOR]/[RIG-GENERIC-AMBIGUOUS]. Called INCOMPLETE rather than SKIP because the structural blocker (no HP pool exists to attach temp HP to) is the dominant reason, not merely the triggered-grant convention.
